VF8-2025.Summary: VinFast Auto, LLC (VinFast) is recalling certain 2023-2025 VF8 vehicles.  The center air bag mounted in the driver's seat may deploy improperly during a side impact crash and strike the driver's arm.
VF8-2025.Consequence: An air bag that strikes the driver increases the risk of injury.
VF8-2025.Remedy: Dealers will replace the center air bag, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed January 23, 2025.  Owners may contact VinFast customer service at 1-833-503-0600.
VF8-2025.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153) or go to nhtsa.gov.

VF8-2024.Summary: VinFast Auto, LLC (VinFast) is recalling certain 2022-2024 VF8 vehicles.  Inactive ignitors may have been installed in the air bags.
VF8-2024.Consequence: Inactive ignitors can prevent the air bags from deploying, increasing the risk of injury during a crash.
VF8-2024.Remedy: VinFast will replace the air bags, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 21, 2024.  Owners may contact VinFast customer service at 1-833-503-0600.  VinFast's number for this recall is VPAC-291.
VF8-2024.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.

VF8-2023.Summary: VinFast Auto, LLC (VinFast) is recalling certain 2023 VF8 vehicles.  A software error may cause the multifunction head unit (MHU) display to go blank.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 101, "Control and Displays."
VF8-2023.Consequence: A blank MHU display will not show critical safety information, such as the speedometer or warning lights, which may increase the risk of a crash.
VF8-2023.Remedy: VinFast will update the software, free of charge.  Owner notification letters were mailed June 1, 2023.  Owners may contact VinFast customer service at 1-833-503-0600.  VinFast's number for this recall is VPAC-74.
VF8-2023.Notes: Owners may also contact the National Highway Traffic Safety Administration Vehicle Safety Hotline at 1-888-327-4236 (TTY 1-800-424-9153), or go to www.nhtsa.gov.
